newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Pedro sets up consultancy subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Pedro sets up consultancy subsidiary.

text.p: Philippines' Central Azucarera Don Pedro (CADP) said on Thursday it had incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, CADP Consultancy Services, to undertake technical service agreements it entered into with foreign sugar millers.
The new company will "undertake design, technology transfer and management projects to maximise its expertise in sugar operations," CADP said in a statement.

CADP recently entered into an agreement with Marubeni Corp to provide technical advice to PT Sweet Indolampung in setting up a 8,000-metric tonne cane per day milling and 700-metric tonne sugar per day refining plant in Indonesia.
It had also been tapped to train management and technical personnel of Saudi Arabia-based United Sugar Company and a Vietnamese company, it added.
